consulo-plugin.name: .ignore Helpers
consulo-plugin.description:
Extra tools for ignore files on top of the platform .ignore language support.

Syntax highlighting, inspections, completion and VCS "Add to ignore file" actions come from the platform; kinds such as .gitignore, .hgignore, .dockerignore or .npmignore are registered by their own plugins. This plugin works with every registered kind and adds:
  • Rules generator based on GitHub's gitignore templates, with filtering by name and content, favorite templates and custom user templates (import/export)
  • Creating ignore files in the selected directory
  • Adding and removing files from ignore rules for kinds without a VCS action
  • Coloring ignored files and hiding them in the Project View
  • Outer rules preview (global .gitignore, .git/info/exclude) in the ignore file editor
  • Covered and unused entry inspections
  • Notifications about a missing .gitignore, unversioned files and editing ignored files
  • Handling tracked ignored files and closing ignored editors
Additional kinds: .bzrignore (Bazaar), .chefignore (Chef), .cfignore (Cloud Foundry), .cvsignore (CVS), .boringignore (Darcs), .ebignore (ElasticBeanstalk), .flooignore (Floobits), ignore-glob (Fossil), .gcloudignore (Google Cloud), .helmignore (Kubernetes Helm), .jpmignore (Jetpack), .mtn-ignore (Monotone), .p4ignore (Perforce), .stylelintignore (StyleLint), .stylintignore (Stylint), .swagger-codegen-ignore (Swagger Codegen), .tfignore (Team Foundation), .upignore (Up)
